usage: Dedicated Spotlight game cover: a magnifying glass examining a ladybug.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium illustrated cover icon for the browser spot-the-difference game Spotlight. Create one beautiful full-bleed landscape image, 3:2 aspect ratio. Primary subject: an elegant brass-rimmed magnifying glass with a dark teal handle inspecting a tiny red ladybug on a fresh green leaf in a sunlit botanical glasshouse. The circular glass lens is very large and unmistakable, occupying most of the central composition, visibly enlarging the ladybug's crisp black spots and the leaf's fine veins underneath. The lens has convincing optical refraction and a delicate edge reflection but stays crystal clear. The diagonal handle extends naturally toward the lower-right corner, fully within the frame. Background: softly focused sage foliage, warm honey sunlight, a hint of elegant greenhouse window framing; keep the background simple enough that the magnifying glass reads instantly at thumbnail size. Style: pristine high-end game illustration with realistic materials and carefully modeled 3D forms, rich warm highlights, polished brass, beautiful soft shadows, sophisticated teal, sage and cream colors with the small ladybug providing a coral-red accent. Cozy, curious, inviting, professional. Compose as one cohesive scene with a strong central silhouette and comfortable margins for a game-card crop. No people or hands, no text, no letters, no logos, no borders, no watermark, no UI, no split screen. The magnifying glass must be the hero and clearly looking at something.
